# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent is already timing-feasible at 7 LUTs and 9 FFs. Iteration 1 preserved behavior and timing but increased LUT use to 10, so it did not improve the `minimize_luts` objective. The top’s numeric latency is unknown; no numeric latency annotation is required.

## Hypothesis
An 8-bit counter with an explicit terminal-count clear may map more compactly than iteration 1’s unconditional increment while preserving the same 0–255 sequence.

## Instruction for generator
Use an 8-bit `counter`, but restore an explicit `if (counter == 8'd255) counter <= 8'd0; else counter <= counter + 8'd1;` update instead of iteration 1’s unconditional increment. Narrow the PWM comparison to `counter < duty`, keeping `pwm_out` registered from the pre-update counter and preserving synchronous reset behavior. Retain this candidate only if the unchanged verification and routed metric gates pass and it strictly improves the incumbent’s LUT/FF objective.
